const m = /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i.exec(($json.headers || {}).authorization || '');
return [{ json: m ? { token: m[1].trim() } : { error: { status: 401, detail: 'Missing token' } } }];

parameters.query: select coalesce((select to_jsonb(p) from (select role, full_name from profiles where id = $1::uuid) p), '{}'::jsonb) as profile

with cl as (select id, name, slug, booking_system, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red, avg_job_value from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),
  'platforms', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x) from (
      select platform,
             sum(spend) spend, sum(impressions) impressions, sum(clicks) clicks, sum(leads) leads, sum(phone_calls) phone_calls,
             sum(reach) reach, sum(unique_link_clicks) unique_link_clicks, sum(unique_outbound_clicks) unique_outbound_clicks,
             sum(video_3s_plays) video_3s_plays, sum(thruplays) thruplays
      from ad_metrics_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by platform
    ) x), '[]'::json),
  'campaigns', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.spend desc) from (
      select m.platform, m.campaign_id, max(m.campaign_name) campaign_name, max(m.campaign_status) campaign_status,
             coalesce(max(csm.service), 'Unclassified') service,
             sum(m.spend) spend, sum(m.impressions) impressions, sum(m.clicks) clicks, sum(m.leads) leads, sum(m.phone_calls) phone_calls,
             sum(m.reach) reach, sum(m.unique_link_clicks) unique_link_clicks, sum(m.unique_outbound_clicks) unique_outbound_clicks,
             sum(m.video_3s_plays) video_3s_plays, sum(m.thruplays) thruplays
      from ad_metrics_daily m
      left join campaign_service_map csm on csm.client_id = m.client_id and csm.platform = m.platform and csm.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
      where m.client_id = (select id from cl) and m.date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by m.platform, m.campaign_id
    ) x), '[]'::json),
  'adsets', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.spend desc) from (
      select m.campaign_id, m.adset_id, max(m.adset_name) adset_name,
             sum(m.spend) spend, sum(m.impressions) impressions, sum(m.clicks) clicks, sum(m.leads) leads, sum(m.phone_calls) phone_calls,
             sum(m.reach) reach, sum(m.unique_link_clicks) unique_link_clicks, sum(m.unique_outbound_clicks) unique_outbound_clicks,
             sum(m.video_3s_plays) video_3s_plays, sum(m.thruplays) thruplays,
             coalesce(max(g.contacts_paid), 0) ghl_contacts, coalesce(max(g.appointments), 0) ghl_appointments
      from adset_metrics_daily m
      left join lateral (
        select sum(contacts_paid) contacts_paid, sum(appointments) appointments from ghl_adset_daily gh
        where gh.client_id = m.client_id and gh.adset_name = m.adset_name and gh.date between $2::date and $3::date
      ) g on true
      where m.client_id = (select id from cl) and m.platform = 'meta' and m.date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by m.campaign_id, m.adset_id
    ) x), '[]'::json),
  'video', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x) from (
      select campaign_id, adset_id, sum(impressions) video_impressions
      from ad_level_metrics_daily
      where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta' and date between $2::date and $3::date and video_3s_plays > 0
      group by campaign_id, adset_id
    ) x), '[]'::json),
  'budgets', coalesce((
    select json_agg(b) from (
      select platform, entity_type, entity_id, campaign_id, status, daily_budget, lifetime_budget, budget_source
      from campaign_budgets where client_id = (select id from cl)
    ) b), '[]'::json),
  'ghl', (
    select to_json(g) from (
      select sum(contacts_created) contacts, sum(contacts_paid_attributed) contacts_paid, sum(leads_dq) leads_dq,
             sum(inbound_calls) inbound_calls, sum(appointments_booked) booked, sum(appointments_all) booked_all,
             sum(appointments_confirmed) confirmed, sum(appointments_showed) showed, sum(appointments_noshow) noshow,
             sum(jobs_won) won, sum(revenue_won) revenue
      from ghl_metrics_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date
    ) g),
  'appts', coalesce((select json_agg(z) from (
with camp as (
  select platform, campaign_id, sum(leads) leads from ad_metrics_daily
  where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date group by 1, 2
),
adsets as (
  select campaign_id, adset_name, sum(leads) leads, sum(spend) spend from adset_metrics_daily
  where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta' and date between $2::date and $3::date group by 1, 2
),
same_name as (select adset_name, sum(leads) leads, sum(spend) spend from adsets group by 1),
booked as (
  select adset_name, sum(appointments) appointments from ghl_adset_daily
  where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date group by 1
),
tagged as (
  select a.campaign_id,
         sum(b.appointments * case when s.leads > 0 then a.leads / s.leads
                                   when s.spend > 0 then a.spend / s.spend else 0 end) appointments
  from booked b join same_name s on s.adset_name = b.adset_name
  join adsets a on a.adset_name = b.adset_name
  group by 1
),
totals as (
  select (select coalesce(sum(appointments_booked), 0) from ghl_metrics_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date) total,
         (select coalesce(sum(appointments), 0) from tagged) tagged_total,
         (select coalesce(sum(leads), 0) from camp) leads
)
select c.platform, c.campaign_id,
       coalesce(t.appointments, 0)
         + greatest(totals.total - totals.tagged_total, 0)
           * case when totals.leads > 0 then c.leads / totals.leads else 0 end as appointments
from camp c cross join totals
left join tagged t on t.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  ) z), '[]'::json)
) end as data
